items.text: Patriots likely to activate A.J. Brown from IR to play vs Jets Sunday after limited practice all week.
items.why: High-ankle sprain IR stint complete; practiced limited, sources confirm activate/play.
items.implication: Immediate WR2/WR3 upside in NE offense vs Jets.
items.opportunity: High target share return; start if active.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Sunday along with Will Shipley; PHI backfield thinned to Dameon Pierce as primary option behind McKee.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP practice week, ruled out Friday.
items.implication: Zero fantasy production; PHI run game collapses further with Hurts also out.
items.opportunity: Volume to remaining RBs (Pierce lead) and pass-catchers in pass-heavy script.

items.text: Jalen Hurts OUT; first game without him, Tanner McKee starts with top-4 pass-catchers healthy but 4th-string RB.
items.why: Superficial blood clot; indefinite sidelined, no IR planned.
items.implication: McKee caps ceiling; pass-catchers still viable but lower floor.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for DeVonta Smith (IN), Goedert, Wicks.

items.text: DK Metcalf (illness) removed from injury report, no designation for Sunday vs TB; Freiermuth (calf) added Q.
items.implication: Full snaps/targets expected; PIT WR1 locked.
items.opportunity: Heavy usage in thin WR room.

items.text: Assuming A.J. Brown active for Patriots, starting him as WR2 wherever rostered.
items.why: Return from IR vs Jets; high upside.

items.text: Unclear on AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder); Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin); Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee + healthy top-4 (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite thin RB (Pierce).
items.why: Practice participation and Friday designations; PIT depth chart forced; PHI pass-catchers intact.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; lean start Metcalf/Olave/Caleb if no setback; PHI pass game resilient.
items.opportunity: Metcalf target spike in 2-WR; PHI WRs/TE volume safe.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT again; Ravens another game without him.
items.implication: Huntley starts; downgrades to BAL pass game.
items.opportunity: Zay Flowers still startable WR2; Andrews bench.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders secondary buffet for pass-catchers.
items.why: Elite matchup vs WSH defense nightmare for WRs.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI as WR6; bankable usage.
Loves George Kittle vs WSH as TE3; WSH defense soft for TEs.
Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI as RB5; elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
Loves Javonte Williams @ GB as RB8; goal-line role key.
items.why: Near-goal-line work + volume vs soft run D.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA as WR28; ugly matchup + QB issues.
Hates Emeka Egbuka vs PIT as WR34; struggled for targets lately.
